fora.v1.EntitlementPeriod.description:
EntitlementPeriod — a paid period, from an entitlement's fora_period_start
 (inclusive) to its fora_period_end (exclusive). Unset when the covering
 entitlement carries no period.
fora.v1.EntitlementPeriod.title: Entitlement Period

fora.v1.ScopeLabel.description:
ScopeLabel — a human-readable name for one scope, such as "Premium" for
 "news:premium". Display only: it grants nothing.
fora.v1.ScopeLabel.title: Scope Label

fora.v1.Subscription.description: Subscription — one of the agent's subscriptions at an issuer.

ends_at.description: When the subscription ends, if it is set to end.

manage_uri.description:
Where a human manages the subscription, on the origin of the
 entitlement_endpoint the agent called.

reference.description: The issuer's own opaque reference for the subscription.

renews_at.description: When the subscription renews, if it does.

scope_labels.description: Optional human-readable labels for those scopes.

fora.v1.Subscription.title: Subscription

description:
GetSubscriptionStatusResponse — the agent's subscriptions at this issuer. An
 agent the issuer does not know gets an empty list.

ext_critical.description: Critical extension keys (COSE crit pattern, RFC 9052).

ver.description:
FORA protocol version — "1.0". Stamped by the sender from a single
 constant; advisory on receive. See "Protocol version" in the file header.

title: Get Subscription Status Response
